name: What is the typical process for searching and acquiring an income-producing property?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for searching and acquiring an income-producing property?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process generally starts with defining your investment criteria and securing pre-approval for financing. Then, you'll search for properties, often with the guidance of a real estate agent familiar with local markets such as Aventura or Brickell. Once a suitable property is found, you make an offer, conduct due diligence including inspections and appraisals, and finally close the deal. The complexity of due diligence can vary significantly depending on the property type and its location.
acceptedAnswer.description: The typical process involves defining criteria, financing, property search, making an offer, due diligence, and closing.
